description: Annotated collage built around a vintage color photograph of heiress Gloria Vanderbilt in white on a brass bed with her two young sons in blue pajamas, in a bedroom with pink gingham walls and a folk-art wall piece above the headboard. Hand-drawn labels mark Vanderbilt as 'Mother', one boy as 'Anderson Cooper', the other as 'Brother', and circle a dark figure in the wall art with lines to an inset photo of a nighttime fire ceremony labeled 'Human Sacrafice' (sic) — imagery resembling the Bohemian Grove Cremation of Care ceremony. A second inset shows adult CNN anchor Anderson Cooper in a suit. The collage claims the artwork depicts human sacrifice; this is an unverified interpretive claim.
text: Human Sacrafice. Mother. Anderson Cooper. Brother.
flags: Collage claims the wall art depicts human sacrifice — unverified interpretive claim
Fire-ceremony inset resembles the Bohemian Grove Cremation of Care but is not confirmed
Second child is a minor in the photo and unnamed in the caption; left unidentified

description: Screenshot of a Q post (tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, 07/19/20) quoting an Anonymous post from one minute earlier. The quoted post contains the official FBI portrait of Director Christopher Wray in a dark suit and red patterned tie before a U.S. flag, defaced with a large red X drawn across his face, plus two reply links. Q's post adds only the quote link, no text; the red X implies a claim against Wray that the drop does not spell out.
